title: Nodics Configuration Layer
readerIntent: Understand how Nodics changes behavior safely without copying framework code.
summary: Nodics composes configuration from reusable defaults and increasingly specific deployment and business contexts, while governed runtime changes add approval, audit, activation, and rollback controls.

sections.heading: Why configuration is a platform capability
paragraphs: A partner can reuse the same framework in several customer applications while each application selects its own modules, endpoints, limits, security rules, and operational behavior. The application changes configuration at the correct layer instead of editing shared framework source.
This reduces upgrade conflicts, makes differences reviewable, and lets operations teams govern eligible runtime changes without creating a second source of truth.

sections.heading: Two related responsibilities
items: Startup configuration composes files and topology before services become ready.
Runtime governance manages explicitly supported configuration contracts through preview, approval, activation, audit, cleanup, and rollback.
Runtime governance supplements the authoritative source and contract; it does not silently replace arbitrary files or executable logic.
